# The Atlas restates the sunset gate's 75 % beside the skill that owns it

## Context

The Atlas states the sunset gate with its own copy of the threshold. `learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md`, `§a2a_contextual_bridge_protocol`, item 1:

> **The Sunset Protocol:** Execute `session-sunset` skill. PRE-DECISION SUNSET GATE: explicitly requires human confirmation (`/sunset` or chat directive) unless context > 75%.

The `session-sunset` skill owns the triggers (its workflow §1) and states the same number twice more. neomjs/neo-agent-skills#145 changes trigger 1; once that lands, this line contradicts the skill.

## The Problem

One fact lives in three artifacts across two repositories. A change to the trigger has to land in both repos, or the Atlas and the skill disagree about when a peer may end a session without the human's word.

## The Architectural Reality

- `learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md:110`. `Design authority:` the line quoted above, a one-clause summary of the skill's workflow §1.
- ADR 0007 gives the Sunset Protocol the disposition `compress-to-trigger`: AGENTS.md keeps the edge-case line, the body lives outside the L1 anchor. The body's home today is the skill, which every repo loads from `node_modules/neo-agent-skills`.
- AGENTS.md's own edge-case line names no number and needs no change.

## The Fix

The Atlas line keeps the gate and drops the number: human confirmation is required unless trigger 1 of the `session-sunset` skill holds. That sentence is true before and after neomjs/neo-agent-skills#145, so merge order is free.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback / Edge Case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Atlas `§a2a_contextual_bridge_protocol` item 1 (existing) | the skill's workflow §1; ADR 0007 | names the skill's trigger 1 instead of a threshold | — | the line itself | diff; no sunset threshold left in the Atlas |

## Decision Record impact

aligned-with ADR 0007. No ADR is amended.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Item 1 names the skill's trigger 1 instead of a threshold; no other Atlas text changes.
- [x] The Atlas holds no sunset threshold of its own.

## Out of Scope

- The rule itself (neomjs/neo-agent-skills#145).
- AGENTS.md and the other items of `§a2a_contextual_bridge_protocol`.

## Related

- neomjs/neo-agent-skills#145 — the rule change this line has to agree with.
